title: Ki yor juróom ñeenti màndarga yi
intro: Ab nit ku juddoo ci ndoorte lu woyof, am ëlëg guñ bind ci bëgg-bëggu Yàlla. Ñu nëbb ko bimu nekkee xale bu ndaw, ñu yar ko ci biir miiru njiit li doon jéema yàq seen askan, ñu mujjee ko woo ci liggéey bu am solo. Amu ñu woon lenn ludul ngëm ak yetu sàmmkat bu woyof, ñu taxaw ci kanamu njiit li gëna am doole ci jamono jooju, di sàkku ñu bàyyi ñi ñu jàpp. Àdduna bi ci boppam melni dafay yëngu ci seen ndigal — ndox mi dafa xaajaloo, asamaan yi wax, réew mu daanu.
clues: Samay fan yu njëkk dañu ànd ak tiitaange — xale yu melni man, njiit lu amul yërmaande la daan rëbb bi ñuy judd, di ragal ëlëg.
Ndox moo ma muccal, ma juddoo ci biir kër buur bi bëggoon ma yàq.
Dama daw sama réew ginaaw bima amee musiba ci lu gaaw, ma nekk sàmmkat bu woyof ci réew mu sori.
Ma dellusi ngir jànkoonte ak njiit lu am doole jooju, yor benn yatt bu woyof ak bataaxal bu leer, di sàkku moom sa bopp ci sama askan.
Ma séddale ndox mu bari ngir ñi ma topp, ma xool ndox mi wann sama noon lëmm.
Ma yéeg ci tundu wu sell ngir am ndigal bu jóge ci Yàlla, ñu jox ma juróom ñeenti màndarga yu leer yuy firndeel dëgg gi.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ تِسْعَ ءَايَـٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَـٰتٍۢ ۖ فَسْـَٔلْ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِذْ جَآءَهُمْ فَقَالَ لَهُۥ فِرْعَوْنُ إِنِّى لَأَظُنُّكَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ مَسْحُورًۭا
verse: And We had certainly given Moses nine evident signs, so ask the Children of Israel [about] when he came to them and Pharaoh said to him, "Indeed I think, O Moses, that you are affected by magic." (17:101)
